about: Two broke hunters of the cohort founded 7 Oct 14:04, from the hive's recorded play (var/runs) and its character DB (8 Oct 14:12, read only): hive-698's repair at 02:51 (Naramin, draenei 9, everything worn at 0%, 22 copper), and hive-732's at 09:50 (Telunti, tauren 9, 121 copper once its junk was sold) and its first fight after it. Repair prices are the server's (`Player::DurabilityRepair`): the lost durability times DurabilityCosts.dbc's multiplier for the item level and subclass times DurabilityQuality.dbc's for the quality, truncated, times the merchant's reputation discount (Friendly, 0.95), truncated; `cost` is from 0%.

hive-698.kit_read: the character DB at 14:12, everything still at 0%, but for the ranged weapon: at 02:51 the Light Crossbow (15807, the entry `repair.first` names, bought for 279 copper at 21:18 by V403), the Silver Crossbow since; the replay of Repair All with it gives the 11 copper recorded
hive-698.after: 53 of its next 59 fights lost, 8 Oct 01:41-06:43, the purse at 11 copper from 02:51 to 06:47

fight_after.then: died again at 10:02:57 and 10:06:04, the gun whole and the tomahawk broken, and from 10:08 with both broken; each of the three against a unit of 12-15 at hand (the ticks), so the case is the reading, not the deaths' cause
